rules.mentorProjection: Levels 26-32 prefer captured rows and bridge their gaps from the existing level-25 baseline; otherwise continue the final numerical segment or existing single-anchor formula. Levels 1-25 are immutable; discrete operations retain the last known definition.
rules.growth: Each ten growth points adds one initial-stat block. Five stars yield three points per level. Other stars use deterministic midpoint 1 + 0.4 * stars, capped at three; local assumption.
rules.skillGrowth: Innate genetic IDs 5000-5999 cap at five (six evolved); other innate skills cap at nine. Reach cap by level 97; comprehension controls the slope. Discrete effects hold until next known level.
rules.experience: Reference table: captured levels 1-14; levels 15-96 use round(12000*(level/14)^2.4/100)*100. Runtime XP requirement = ceil(reference / 10), minimum one. Level 97 cap. Existing accumulated XP is preserved.
rules.unknownQuality: nearest captured family base stats times [0.65,0.75,0.85,0.93,1] quality ratio; +20% only for uncaptured evolved base stats
rules.unmappedEffects: Recorded operations retained where available; description-only operations remain flagged, never claimed verified.
